Create a small Kotlin program that prints "Hello, World!" to the console.

First, the program must print exactly: "Hello, World!"
Then, the expected output is:
  "Hello, World!"
Also, add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the build on every push to the main branch
Also, use a meaningful name for the workflow file, like test-hello-world.yml
Also, add clear comments and follow Kotlin best practices
Finally, a CI badge (optional)
